task.instruction: Create exactly one valid closed solid triangular prism. In local coordinates its base triangle is (0,0,0), (80,0,0), (0,40,0), closed back to the start, and it extends 25 mm along local +Z. Rotate this geometry +30 degrees about the WORLD Z axis through world (0,0,0), then translate it by world vector (120,-40,15) mm. These operations specify the final pose, not a mandatory tool sequence. Preserve the triangle's handedness. Remove the construction profile and leave no other objects. All units are millimeters. Verify your work using available tools. Match positions and dimensions within 0.001 mm; volume and area may differ by up to 1%.

task.instruction: Build exactly one open planar rectangular patch with a circular opening, as a single Brep face, in millimeters. In local coordinates its outer rectangle runs from (0,0,0) to (100,80,0). Remove the interior of the circle centered at (30,45,0) with radius 12. The opening must be an actual hole through the surface. Rotate this local shape 35 degrees about the world X axis through the origin, then translate by [60, -25, 15]. These define the final world coordinates, not rotation about the shape center. Leave only the final patch and no curves, cutters, solids or other objects. Choose your construction with the available RhinoMCP tools. Match the analytic plane, local bounds and circular/rectangular boundaries within 0.001 mm; area may differ by up to 1%. The opening and prescribed pose remain required.

task.instruction: Build exactly one open rectangular curved panel as a single Brep face in millimeters. In its local coordinates, 0 <= x <= 100 and 0 <= y <= 80, the surface is z = 16 * (20) * (x/100) * (1-x/100) * (y/80) * (1-y/80). All four edges have local z=0; the center has local z=20. Rotate this local shape 65 degrees about the world X axis through the origin, then translate by [120, -40, 30]. These define the final world coordinates, not a rotation about the shape center. Leave no other objects. The rectangular boundary must have no holes. Use the available RhinoMCP tools. Surface deviation may be up to 0.5 mm; local bounds and rectangular boundary must match within 0.001 mm. Topology and prescribed pose remain required.
